code:
%token IF THEN ELSE COND OTHER
%%
s: IF COND THEN s
 | IF COND THEN s ELSE s
 | OTHER
 ;
%%
description: The dangling-else grammar allows competing attachments for ELSE in nested conditionals. You can compare the statement alternatives that create that choice.

steps.description: The declaration names the conditional tokens and OTHER. The marker starts the grammar.
The first alternative is a conditional without ELSE. The second extends the same prefix with ELSE and another statement.
OTHER supplies another statement form. The remaining punctuation closes the rule and grammar section.

title: Read the dangling-else grammar
